name: Aleph Alpha
tagline: European multimodal LLM API with built-in explainability features.
description: Aleph Alpha provides a European-hosted generative AI API for completion, chat, embeddings, and multimodal tasks, with strong emphasis on transparency and explainability for enterprise use.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve account and key management in the Aleph Alpha console.

use_cases: generate text completions with European-hosted LLMs
run multimodal prompt tasks with images and text
use explainability features for model decision transparency
